## Interactive Reference Browser

Interactive reference browser of the full literature collection with the `DT` package [@R-DT].

```{r datatable_clean_bib_data, include=FALSE}
# Minimal interactive table
DT::datatable(
  clean_bib_data %>%
    select(
      Author = AUTHOR,
      Year = YEAR,
      Title = TITLE
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Year), Author),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 5,
    lengthMenu = c(5, 10, 20),
    dom = 'tip'  # table, info, pagination only
  ),
  caption = "Reference List",
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "none"  # remove filter to save space
)
```
